4/8-connected, nodata stays empty

div.style: color: rgb(74, 51, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Distance units
meters → layer CRS units
(geographic CRS: m/° at data centre)

div.style: color: rgb(74, 51, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S1 Load
global poly_id · quantise to precision grid
orient rings: shell CCW, hole CW (body on the LEFT)

div.style: color: rgb(74, 51, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S2a Junction insertion (per tile)
insert neighbour vertices lying on an edge
(GDAL omits vertices where 3 polygons meet)

div.style: color: rgb(74, 51, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S2b Densify
apply insertions → neighbours share identical vertices

div.style: color: rgb(90, 23, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S2c LPoly/RPoly labelling (per tile)
edge p→q of A: RPoly = owner of q→p, else 0
emit shared edge once (lpoly < rpoly) · split where RPoly changes

div.style: color: rgb(74, 51, 5) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S3 Merge
re-join arc pieces cut by tile edges
closed arcs → canonical start vertex

div.style: color: rgb(90, 23, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S4 Smooth every arc once
default: Gaussian sliding average (sigma ≈ 1.25 pixel)
(or Chaikin / B-Spline / Bezier / Douglas-Peucker)
arc nodes fixed · raster-extent arcs kept straight
self-crossing → gentle smoothing only around the crossing

div.style: color: rgb(90, 23, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S5 Reconstruct (per poly_id batch)
arcs: forward if LPoly, reversed if RPoly
face walk (first arc clockwise at nodes) · split self-touching rings

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
valid polygon?
(GEOS)

div.style: color: rgb(47, 33, 71) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(90, 23, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
S6 Repair
find where arcs of the polygon cross/touch
smooth gently only in windows around those points
(windows grow each round) → then whole arc:
half strength → corner cutting → original
rebuild the polygon and its neighbours
